title: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Externally-Accessible File or Directory vulnerability in Looks Awesome…
description: A vulnerability in Flow-Flow Social Stream (up to version 5.0.5) allows insertion of sensitive information into files or directories that are externally accessible. This could lead to unauthorized retrieval of embedded sensitive data. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-125799 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5.
